extraFacts.fact: KC (king combination) nipples are hose tails: a serrated shank that goes inside the hose, and a threaded, grooved or flanged end that connects to pipe or another fitting; the hose is held on the tail by a clamp, ferrule or sleeve, and that sets how much pressure the joint holds. Part-number suffixes are the size in hundredths of an inch (050 is 1/2 inch, 400 is 4 inch, 1200 is 12 inch).
extraFacts.source: Indus Hydraulics KC nipple listings (family text and size table suffixes)

faqs.q: What is the 206 hose hammer union coupling used for?
faqs.a: The 206 hose hammer union coupling is a Figure 206 hammer union joined to a multi-serration hose tail for interlocking ferrules. It joins a hose to a Figure 206 hammer union line for multi-purpose fluid, chemical and bulk handling. See the [KC nipple fittings shelf](/c/kc-nipple-fittings).

faqs.q: How do I read the 206 hose hammer union coupling part numbers?
faqs.a: The last digits of a part number are the size in hundredths of an inch: for example IH-KC-206-HOSE-HAMMER-UNION-400 is the first of 1 sizes, from 4". Quote the full number, or the size and material.

faqs.q: What sizes does the 206 hose hammer union coupling come in?
faqs.a: The 206 hose hammer union coupling is listed in 4", as 1 sizes in the part-number table. Specify the exact size on the request, because lead time depends on size and material.

faqs.q: What working pressure does the 206 hose hammer union coupling have?
faqs.a: No working pressure is published for it. Give us your working pressure and medium and we check it with the manufacturer before supply. Share the duty and any standard that applies and we will confirm the match.

faqs.q: What is the 206 hose hammer union coupling made of?
faqs.a: The 206 hose hammer union coupling is listed in Carbon Steel, Aluminum, Brass, or 316 SS. Forged carbon steel with plated. Multi-purpose fluid, chemical, bulk handling. Choose the material against the fluid and the surroundings, and state the fluid when you order.

faqs.q: Does Indus supply test certificates with the 206 hose hammer union coupling?
faqs.a: No certificate or approval is listed for the 206 hose hammer union coupling. If your project needs a test report or material certificate, state it on your [request](/contact) and we confirm what is available before supply.

faqs.q: What does the 206 hose hammer union coupling connect to?
faqs.a: End A is "Figure 206 hammer union" and end B is "Multi-serration hose tail, for interlocking ferrules". The hose is held on the tail by a clamp, ferrule or sleeve, which sets how much pressure the joint holds; see the [KC nipples and shank couplings guide](/blog/kc-nipples-and-shank-couplings).

faqs.q: How do I fit the 206 hose hammer union coupling to a hose?
faqs.a: Push the hose fully on to the serrated tail and secure it with a clamp, ferrule or sleeve suited to the hose; the clamp or ferrule sets the joint rating. Multi-serration hose tail. Compatible with Interlocking ferrules.
